handoffs.lead: A federal jury convicted former AFGE Local 2419 president Kimberly Goodwin on August 31, 2026, of participating in a wire-fraud conspiracy and eight money-laundering counts. DOJ said the DOL OIG National Capital Region Office of Investigations investigated the case; the conduct involved approximately $1 million in union funds and personal expenditures.
handoffs.source_title: Maryland Union Leader Convicted of Defrauding Union To Enrich Herself
handoffs.reason: This is a federal criminal conviction and is routed to A04. Goodwin's AFGE union role is not evidence of right-wing, Republican, conservative, Trump-administration, or other qualifying affiliation, so A02 emits no event.
